content.text: What format does the 18-digit health identifier use?

The 18-digit form is a GS1 Global Service Relation Number; a shorter 10-digit form is also defined for display [DOC-ID-02]. The field is populated from the identifier index and is not typed in by hand [DOC-ID-02].

content.text: Is there guidance on privacy impact assessment for a new system?

Yes. Assess privacy risk before the system goes live and again when its use of information changes [DOC-PIA-03]. The retrieved guidance does not cover AI-specific assessment, so check with your data protection officer.
